calendarRoutingMode.user_pick: I pick the calendar per record

labels.calendarSyncModeHelp: Background calendar sync is off. Use **Add to Google Calendar** on records to export manually. Showing Google events inside the CRM calendar is a separate preference (when available).
labels.googleAccountProfileMissing: Connected with an older authorization. Reconnect this Google account to show its email, name and avatar.
labels.googleConnectWarningText: This app has **not** been verified by Google. During Connect, Google will show an *"unverified app"* warning screen — click **Advanced**, then **Go to (app name) (unsafe)** to continue. Only connect if you understand and accept this risk. This integration is for **internal Safehouse use only** — do not connect accounts you do not manage yourself.
labels.googleConnectRiskCheckboxLabel: I have read this warning and understand the risks
labels.googleConnectRiskCheckboxRequired: Check "I have read this warning and understand the risks" before connecting.
labels.oauthSafetyAckHint: Connect / Reconnect stay disabled until this box is checked. After you connect, the checkbox locks until you disconnect.
labels.overlayCalendarIdListHelp: Choose which personal Google calendars to show inside the CRM calendar. CRM-created calendars are never listed here. Default is the primary calendar only. Events older than 1 month are removed automatically.
labels.googleCalendarNamingPatternHelp: Calendar name will include the admin prefix/suffix (read-only).

messages.googleConnectRiskCheckboxRequired: Check "I have read this warning and understand the risks" before connecting.

help.GoogleCalendarDrive: Use **Connect** to authorize Google. While connected: **Reconnect** switches account; **Disconnect** clears tokens (same as turning off **Enabled** + **Save**). After connecting, verify email/name/avatar, then **Save**. Calendar export is manual only (per-record **Add to Google Calendar**).

tooltips.calendarRoutingMode: Primary calendar = your main Google calendar for all exports. I pick the calendar per record = choose (or create) a calendar on each record. Dedicated calendar (auto) = CRM creates/reuses one calendar per entity type automatically.
tooltips.overlayCalendarIdList: Personal calendars to overlay into the CRM calendar. CRM-managed calendars cannot be selected.
